officialApiPricing.tier: Standard API starting rate; fast variant twice input/output price

independentDeepSWE.unit: pass@1 is attempt pass rate over scored rollout attempts. pass@4 is tasks with at least one passing rollout divided by tasks attempted. Context-window failures and agent timeouts are scored failures; provider/verifier/network errors are excluded. Efficiency aggregates are over every scored attempt.

gapsAndConflicts.finding: Full cross-model benchmark coverage is not published. Missing records must remain unavailable; a missing record is neither zero nor a predecessor score.
Sonnet release explicitly says GPT-6 Sol Terminal-Bench4.0 and CursorBench4.0 results were not publicly reported; it uses GPT-5.6 Sol instead.
Fable5 has CursorBench3.2.0 effort curve, not a verified CursorBench4.0 result in these sources. Fable5.1 has separate curves for both versions. Never merge3.2.0 into4.0.
Terminal4.0 cost axes differ: Sonnet/Opus release use per-attempt; Fable release uses mean-per-task. Preserve them as separate cost bases.
GDPval-AA v2 andv2.1 Elo scores depend on comparison pool/snapshot; preserve version. Publisher GDPval-AA2.1 costs are explicitly estimates.
xAI table reports Fable5.1 Terminal4.0=57.9%; Anthropic Fable/Opus tables report55.8%. xAI labels it Max; preserve source-specific disagreement, do not average.
Source-date numerical curves can peak below max effort: Opus5.5 Terminal4.0 peaks66.4% atxhigh, Sonnet FrontierCode52.1% atxhigh vs46.2% atmax. Do not identify max as automatically strongest.
Fable/Mythos share weights but safeguards and fallback routing affect evaluated scores; distinct named systems must remain separate.

confidence.transcriptionAndPricing: High: all focused accessible curves matched live primary HTML and official pricing docs corroborate rates.
confidence.completeness: Limited: unpublished values cannot be supplied, and this review does not independently rerun provider benchmarks.
confidence.guarantee: No100% empirical accuracy guarantee. Confidence applies to faithful transcription and preserved source conditions.
